problems: Overlap with Cliopatria aggregates: french-west-africa, french-equatorial-africa, anglo-egyptian-sudan, italian-libya and german-east-africa are drawn inside the continental aggregates 'French Africa', 'British Africa', 'Italian Africa' and 'German Africa'. The renderer must decide which one draws the land.

Gazetteer cell counts undercount deserts: Libya resolves to 0.78 of its infobox area, and the country W. Sahara covers only the Polisario-held zone (about 84,000 km2), so area ratios in keyframe notes are rough.

Mirror events are missing in other groups' dossiers: the Federal Republic of Somalia needs a 1991 loss of the north to Somaliland and a 1998 loss to Puntland; Morocco needs the occupation of Western Sahara from 1976; the French Africa and British Africa aggregates need the mirror of the colony splits.

Open relations are left without an _end event (Morocco's occupation of Western Sahara, the Las Anod stalemate, Somaliland-Puntland Sool and Sanaag dispute), so the validator reports unpaired start warnings only.
Unknown counterpart slugs (warnings only): french-togoland, maakhir, senussi-order, ssc-khatumo, uganda-protectorate (af-05); and the gazetteer lacks the nine names listed in gazetteer_names_needed.

WebFetch summarises long pages and often answered 'not on the page' for dated sentences; those silences are recorded at confidence 1 or as notes, never filled from memory. Pages read on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 carry the matching accessed dates.
